description.value:
You twist time to force a creature to relive the worst moment of its recent past. This spell is cast as a reaction triggered when a creature within range is the target of an attack or fails a saving throw. The target must attempt a Will save against your spell DC. On a failure, the target takes mental damage equal to the damage of the triggering attack (if any), up to a maximum of 4d6 mental damage. If the trigger was a saving throw the target succeeded at, on a failed Will save the target must also immediately retry that saving throw with a -2 status penalty, applying the new result (even if it is worse).

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target takes mental damage up to 4d6 (matching the triggering hit's damage, capped at 4d6). If the trigger was a saving throw the target succeeded at, it must retry the save with a -2 status penalty.

Critical Failure The target takes the maximum mental damage (4d6, treated as if all dice rolled their max value) and, if the trigger was a saving throw, must retry it with a -4 status penalty.

Heightened (+1) The maximum mental damage increases by 1d6.
